title: One mailbox message produced two wake notifications for the same sequence
outcome: Single observation from Phoenix::Fable report 17 (Engram pilot via Engram::Advisor 2026-09-06): Codex mailbox #373 woke the receiver twice; the message itself was appended once (no duplicate row). No claim about root cause or about a stronger-than-documented delivery guarantee; wake delivery is best-effort metadata and duplicates are tolerable by protocol. Task: correlate wake dispatch with message identity in diagnostics (log the message id and disposition per wake) so a repeat can be classified as coalescing, retry after a lost response, or a real double dispatch; fix only if a real double dispatch is found. Acceptance: a wake log line carries mailbox id, sequence, message id and disposition; a test pins one wake per append on the ordinary path.
